item.title: Low-dose digoxin reduces heart-failure hospitalizations by 25%
item.description:
New research suggests that low-dose digoxin, a highly affordable drug, can reduce hospitalizations for heart-failure patients by approximately 25%. This finding could lead to the drug's return as a primary treatment option.

item.description:
